resolvedStack: Electron + Next.js 14 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Prisma + NextAuth + Stripe
name: DockFlow Container Desk
description: DockFlow Container Desk is a native Electron developer workstation for orchestrating local container clusters, inspecting live service logs, managing environment profiles, and handling Pro license subscriptions.

metadata.name: DockFlow Container Desk
metadata.description: Electron developer desktop manager for container clusters, service logs, and env profiles.

files.description: Electron, Next.js 14, React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Prisma 5, NextAuth v4, stripe, zod, lucide-react, react-icons.
PostgreSQL Prisma schema with Role, ContainerState, LogLevel enums and User, ContainerCluster, ServiceLog, EnvProfile models.
Shared TypeScript interfaces for ContainerCluster, ServiceLog, EnvProfile.
Tailwind CSS directives for developer desktop console.
Root layout with SessionProvider, Navbar, and Footer.
Desktop welcome screen for DockFlow Container Desk.
Desktop Command Center mounting ClusterOverview, ServiceLogsPanel, and EnvProfilesPanel.
Client renderer component displaying container clusters from /api/clusters.
Client renderer component showing service logs from /api/logs with level filters.
Client renderer component managing environment variable profiles.
Client hook fetching /api/clusters on mount via useEffect.
GET and POST API route for ContainerCluster records.
GET and POST API route for ServiceLog records.
